review_candidates.title: Vice President, EMEA Marketing
review_candidates.description: Job Requisition ID JR2024666 Job Category Marketing Time Type Full time NVIDIA is seeking a dynamic, strategic, and visionary Vice President of EMEA Marketing to lead and elevate our marketing strategy across Europe, the Middle East, and Africa. Reporting directly to the Chief Marketing Officer (CMO), this is a highly visible executive leadership role responsible for driving regional growth, accelerating developer adoption, and expanding NVIDIA’s leadership across AI Infrastructure, Sovereign AI, Omniverse, Physical AI, and our rapidly expanding software ecosystem. As a key member of the Global Marketing leadership team, you will design and execute a comprehensive EMEA marketing strategy aligned with NVIDIA’s overarching business objectives. You will lead a high-performing, geographically dispersed regional marketing organization, orchestrating integrated programs across field marketing, enterprise campaigns, partner marketing, and high-impact developer programs. Working in close partnership with Worldwide Field Operations (WWFO), Developer Relations, Product Marketing, Corporate Communications, and executive leadership, you will ensure global marketing strategies are localized to meet the distinct cultural, economic, and regulatory needs of EMEA markets while leveraging the full power of NVIDIA’s global teams and partners. What You'll Be Doing Strategic Leadership: Define and execute NVIDIA’s integrated marketing vision across the diverse EMEA footprint, aligning regional priorities with global corporate strategies. Ecosystem Engagement: Drive deep engagement across the entire NVIDIA ecosystem, from AI startups and developer communities to Fortune 500 enterprises, research universities, and governments. Sales Alignment: Partner seamlessly with the EMEA Worldwide Field Operations (WWFO) leadership team to co-develop integrated strategies that drive engagement and accelerate revenue. Market Intelligence: Synthesize regional customer trends, competitive dynamics, and regulatory shifts to shape future global marketing investments and product positioning. Functional Excellence, including regional events: Lead and inspire a world-class regional team spanning partner marketing, enterprise campaigns, developer relations marketing, and major events (e.g. GTC). Cultural & Operational Stewardship: Foster a high-accountability, fast-paced culture of innovation and continuous improvement, ensuring regional execution maintains absolute alignment with NVIDIA’s brand and global initiatives. What We Need To See Executive Experience: 15+ overall years of progressive B2B technology marketing leadership, with a proven track record of managing large, matrixed marketing organizations across EMEA. GTM Track Record: Demonstrated success in developing regional marketing strategies that measurably scale enterprise pipeline, developer adoption, and brand equity. Matrix Mastery: 6+ years of exceptional ability to navigate complex, highly matrixed global organizations and build deep, collaborative partnerships with executive sales leaders and product teams. Domain Expertise: Strong foundational understanding of accelerated computing, enterprise AI, cloud architecture, and the developer ecosystem. Understanding of what drives AI adoption. Presence & Influence: Outstanding executive presence with the communication and stakeholder management skills required to represent NVIDIA at the highest levels with partners, customers, and internal leadership. Agility: Proven ability to lead organizational transformation during periods of rapid industry evolution. Experience in scale-ups and/or high growth hyperscale organizations. Bachelors degree or equivalent experience. Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd Developer-First Mindset: Deep experience marketing platform technologies and building thriving developer ecosystems. European Regulatory Acumen: Familiarity navigating EMEA’s complex regulatory landscape, specifically around data sovereignty and AI governance, to position NVIDIA as the trusted partner for regional AI infrastructure. Hyper-Growth Execution: Proven experience scaling a regional marketing engine during a period of exponential market demand and technological disruption. Ecosystem Networks: Existing, strong relationships within the EMEA enterprise, cloud service provider (CSP), and startup ecosystems. With competitive salaries and a generous benefits package, (www.nvidiabenefits.com), we are widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people in the world working for us and, due to outstanding growth, our best-in-class teams are rapidly growing. If you're a creative, hardworking marketing executive, then we want to hear from you.

review_candidates.title: Technician - Mechanical
review_candidates.description: Workplace Type: Onsite About Newmont At Newmont, we’re not just a world-leading gold and metals producer – we’re a team united by our commitment to shaping a more inclusive, sustainable, and responsible mining industry. Joining us means becoming part of a global, diverse workforce where everyone is valued, empowered, and encouraged to grow. Our people are the heart of our success, bringing exceptional skill, integrity, and dedication to everything we do as an organization and we’re dedicated to creating a workplace where everyone can thrive. About Lihir Our Lihir Operation, located on the beautiful island of Niolam, approximately 800km north of Papua New Guinea's capital, Port Moresby, is one of the world’s largest gold mines. Set within a geothermically active, extinct volcanic crater, Lihir operates an open-pit mine producing refractory ore, which undergoes pressure oxidation and conventional leaching to recover gold. Our workforce includes both residential and commute rosters, creating a diverse and dynamic team. Lihir offers a range of recreational facilities, including a gym, sports club, restaurant, bar, swimming pool, tennis and squash courts, and a 9-hole golf course. For those who enjoy the outdoors, the Lihir fishing and boating clubs provide access to pristine waters and beaches, while our onsite deli and café serve fresh local and imported produce, barista-made coffee, and freshly baked goods. We are proud to work closely with the local Lihirian community and value its vibrant culture. Through initiatives like our School to Mine program, we offer meaningful employment, training, and development opportunities for Lihirian men and women, as well as scholarships and vocational apprenticeships. We also partner with the New Ireland Province to ensure economic benefits flow directly to the community, strengthening our commitment to sustainable development and positive local impact. Purpose As a Technician Mechanical, you'll play an important role in keeping our operations running safely and efficiently. Through inspections, maintenance, troubleshooting, and repairs, you'll help maximise equipment reliability and availability while contributing to a proactive maintenance culture that supports continuous plant performance. Essential Duties Perform mechanical inspections and identify potential issues before they impact operations. Diagnose and repair mechanical equipment to minimise downtime and restore performance. Carry out maintenance activities safely and in line with site standards and procedures. Monitor equipment condition and performance to identify early signs of failure. Assist with the calibration and testing of mechanical components and systems. Maintain accurate maintenance records, equipment histories, and work documentation. Support spare parts management by helping track critical component usage and availability. Identify and report mechanical defects, risks, and improvement opportunities. Work closely with colleagues and supervisors to deliver safe, reliable, and efficient maintenance outcomes. Champion a strong safety culture and actively contribute to achieving zero harm. Training & Experience Demonstrated experience in mechanical maintenance within mining, processing, heavy industry, or a similar operational environment. Strong mechanical troubleshooting and fault-finding capability. Understanding of preventative, predictive, and corrective maintenance practices. Experience maintaining detailed maintenance records and equipment history documentation. Knowledge of asset management principles and equipment reliability practices. Sound understanding of health, safety, and environmental requirements in an operational environment. Ability to interpret technical information and follow maintenance procedures. Strong communication and teamwork skills, with the ability to build positive working relationships across disciplines. High attention to detail, strong problem-solving skills, and a commitment to continuous improvement. A proactive approach to safety and a willingness to stop unsafe work. Working Conditions This role is offered on a 28:14 Day / Night Fly in, Fly out (FIFO) roster to Lihir Island, PNG from our approved POH. Our FIFO employees stay in a secure and comfortable camp, in an en-suite and air-conditioned room equipped with mini fridge, TV and Wi-Fi. A variety of healthy meal options are catered for at our mess; and the wet mess provides a relaxed social setting where employees can unwind with a game of pool or darts. At Newmont, our commitment to diversity and inclusion ensures that everyone can work to their full potential, free from discrimination, while respecting the cultures, religions, and governance of the regions in which we operate. Guided by our values of Safety, Integrity, Sustainability, Responsibility, and Inclusion, our Lihir team – 90% of which are Papua New Guinean – is dedicated to creating a culturally rich and supportive environment where meaningful, long-term connections can be formed within the industry. We believe in the strength of our people and the positive impact we can create together. Newmont employees are rewarded with a competitive salary, flexible packaging options, and programs that recognize those who go above and beyond. We know no candidate meets every qualification listed, so if you share our values and feel you can make a meaningful contribution, we encourage you to apply – we’d love to hear from you!

review_candidates.title: Tech Operations Engineer
review_candidates.description: Je bouwt, beheert en verbetert onze digitale operatie Rotterdam · Hybride · Stichting Socialdebt Waar je aan werkt Eén op de vijf jongeren in Nederland heeft serieuze geldproblemen. Socialdebt neemt schulden tot € 2.500 over en combineert dat met persoonlijke coaching, opdrachten en een beloningssysteem, zonder boetes en zonder kosten. Onze aanpak is grotendeels digitaal: jongeren regelen alles via de Socialdebt-app, coaches werken met de jongeren en worden ondersteund door onze interne systemen. Dat betekent dat onze techniek geen bijzaak is. Als een factuur niet doorkomt, een aflossing niet wordt aangemaakt of een notificatie niet afgaat, merkt een jongere dat meteen. Jij zorgt dat die digitale operatie dag in dag uit klopt. Wat je doet Je bent een belangrijke schakel in onze digitale operatie: je zorgt dat die betrouwbaar draait én dat we hem stap voor stap slimmer maken. Ontwikkelen en verbeteren: het grootste deel van je week Je bouwt en verbetert onze automatiseringen en koppelingen (bijvoorbeeld met N8N) en maakt handwerk overbodig. Je werkt aan onze datastromen en rapportage: van ruwe data uit meerdere bronnen naar cijfers waarop we kunnen sturen. Je verbetert onze datakwaliteit, van instroom en triage tot aflossingen en voortgang. Je voert functionele verbeteringen in onze interne omgeving zelf door en werkt mee aan technische en dataprojecten. Je zet AI in waar het helpt: van slimme automatiseringen en tekstverwerking tot het sneller doorgronden van data. Daarbij bewaak je zorgvuldigheid en privacy, want het gaat om gegevens van jongeren. De operatie op orde houden Je beheert onze interne omgeving, inclusief rechten en rollen. Je onderzoekt technische meldingen: je reproduceert, analyseert en zet een heldere bevinding in Jira, of je lost het zelf op. Je test nieuwe versies van de app en webapp voordat ze live gaan, en beoordeelt of een ticket echt af is. Je legt oplossingen vast in ons handboek, zodat een vraag maximaal één keer gesteld hoeft te worden. Wie je bent Wij zoeken iemand die logisch en analytisch denkt, maar ook creatief meedenkt. Iemand die dingen af maakt en die het leuk vindt om samen een probleem stap voor stap uit te pluizen. Wat we in ieder geval vragen: Je hebt eerder verantwoordelijkheid gedragen voor een applicatie of digitaal proces. Je onderzoekt technische problemen zelfstandig en systematisch. Je hebt ervaring met softwaretesting of kwaliteitscontrole. Je werkt nauwkeurig met data en hebt gewerkt met databases, automatiseringen of complexe datamodellen. Je kunt techniek uitleggen aan mensen die geen techneut zijn. Fijn als je daarnaast hebt: ervaring met low-code of automatiseringstools (Airtable, N8N, Make, Zapier); ervaring met data-analyse, dashboards of BI (SQL, Power BI of vergelijkbaar); gevoel voor gebruikers en toegankelijkheid; affiniteit met ons maatschappelijke vraagstuk. Waar je werkt en met wie Onze homebase is Rotterdam. Je werkt grotendeels hybride, met minimaal één vaste dag per week op kantoor met het hele team. Je werkt 3 dagen per week (24 uur). Je werkt nauw samen met onze Product Lead, Operational Data Analist en Operational Lead, en op de achtergrond met onze externe developmentpartner. Je komt in een klein team waarin je snel zichtbaar verschil maakt en waarin je direct met alle lagen van de organisatie schakelt. Wat we bieden Een rol met veel eigenaarschap in een organisatie die echt iets verandert voor jongeren met schulden. Directe invloed op hoe onze systemen, processen en data eruitzien. Ruimte om te leren: van applicatiebeheer richting data, automatisering en productontwikkeling. Marktconform salaris. Solliciteren Stuur je cv en motivatie naar hallo@socialdebt.nl vóór 15 september 2026.

Saudi Arabian Bechtel Company has been appointed to provide project management consultancy services (including technical, commercial, and construction management) for the development of a state of the art international airport in the city of Riyadh, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. Job Summary Reporting to the Project BIM Manager the BIM Lead – 4D is responsible for developing the digital vision and implementing the end-to-end Project Information Management strategy, execution plan, and deployment for Aviation projects. This role requires deep expertise in BIM for Aviation infrastructure, ensuring that digital solutions are effectively integrated into the design and construction. The role champions the innovation culture on project and provides advice and support to project leadership team and customer regarding emerging technologies including proven innovation and digital solutions to support project delivery and customer goals. This role is also fully responsible for 4D modelling and visualization, overseeing sequencing, process development, and documentation to ensure alignment with project requirements. Lead the 4D sequencing program by linking BIM models with project schedules to support construction simulation, progress tracking, and reporting. Coordinate and review 4D planning activities, including program reviews and activity plans, ensuring alignment with project timelines. Report regularly on 4D model status, highlighting progress, issues, and corrective actions; support context modeling and digital engineering integration. Drive innovation and continuous improvement in 4D systems, workflows, and data environments. Develop and implement strategies for integrating 4D modeling, visualization, and digital construction solutions to optimize project execution. Support the PMIS team with presentations and training to promote effective use of 4D modeling for project outcomes. Train and guide end users on interpreting and applying 4D outputs to support decision-making and delivery. Assist with management of the project the Common Data Environment (CDE), including model federation, quality control of 2D/3D deliverables, and issue resolution with stakeholders. Develop processes for model-based quantity take-offs to enable construction quantity reporting and forecasting. Oversee and coordinate BIM activities across design and construction subcontractors, ensuring alignment in coordinate systems, templates, clash management, and model coordination. Train and support project teams on BIM workflows and CDE tools (e.g., ACC, Aconex, Revizto, ArcGIS). Conduct regular assessments of BEP implementation, capturing lessons learned and driving workflow improvements. Act as a liaison between the customer, project teams, and IT to resolve BIM-related challenges and ensure smooth execution. Provide operational support to BIM Coordinators, including BIM Leads from third-party engineering firms and subcontractors. Support design and construction reviews, managing issue/action logs and ensuring alignment with project goals. Work strategically with stakeholders to align objectives, mitigate risks, and ensure high-quality deliverables. Prepare and present reports, documentation, and project updates to senior leadership BIM Management (secondary Responsibility) Develop, implement, and maintain BIM standards and protocols. Supervise and manage BIM model development for all disciplines (including sub-consultants and vendors) to LOD 300, with structured data for future progression to LOD 400/500. Supervise and manage BIM model development for all disciplines (including sub-contractors and vendors) to LOD 400, supporting engineering activities, and final delivery at LOD 500. Assist with seamless information handover from Lead Design Consultants (LDC) to contractors, including: Review of design stage gate deliverables. Minimum 5 years’ experience as BIM/CAD Manager/BIM lead leveraging or managing technology in design and construction(preferred). Required Knowledge And Skills Expert-level proficiency in 4D planning tools, especially Synchro, and other BIM/GIS software for 4D implementation. Solid technical expertise in a core discipline, with broad understanding of related disciplines—ideally in airport terminals or similarly complex facilities. Experience developing BIM templates, standards, classification systems, class libraries, and master data models on large-scale projects. Familiarity with project delivery methods: Design-Bid-Build, Design/Build, Integrated Project Delivery (IPD), and LEAN. Knowledge of Common Data Environment (CDE) platforms like ACC/BIM 360, ProjectWise, and Aconex. Working knowledge of collaboration and data management tools such as Navisworks, Assemble, and CostOS. Cultural awareness and ability to work effectively in diverse, multicultural teams. Problem-solving mindset with a focus on integrated project delivery and industry best practices. Self-driven with strong leadership and the ability to influence without formal authority. Ability to manage competing priorities and adapt to evolving responsibilities. Collaborative team player with the capacity to guide and train engineering and construction staff. Large infrastructure or Aviation planning, design and construction. Experience of large commercial multi-level structures. Knowledge of major projects, heavy civil works or infrastructure. Experience with design and integration of specialist systems. review_candidates.title: Sales Executive | België | Remote
review_candidates.description: Saga is een legal innovation company met de missie om alles weg te halen wat tussen juridische expertise en echte impact staat, zodat advocaten zich kunnen richten op wat het meest telt: mensen, ethiek en impact. We zijn opgericht in Noorwegen en vanaf dag 1 gebouwd voor de juridische praktijk. We sluiten aan op lokale rechtsbronnen in meerdere jurisdicties en zijn beschikbaar in 12 talen. Op 18 maanden tijd groeiden we tot 85+ medewerkers en 6.000+ gebruikers in ruim 20 landen. In Noorwegen en Nederland zijn we marktleider, en nu breiden we uit naar de rest van Europa. België is de volgende stap. We geloven dat technologie het juridisch denkwerk moet versterken, niet vervangen. Zo kan het recht werken zoals het bedoeld is: eenduidig, controleerbaar en in staat om iedereen recht te doen. Jouw rol als Sales Executive bij Saga De meeste advocatenkantoren in België hebben nog nooit gezien wat AI echt met hun werk kan doen. Jij bent diegene die het hun toont. Soms is dat een gesprek van 20 minuten waarin iemand beleefd afhoudt. En soms is het het moment waarop een vennoot even stil valt en zegt: dit scheelt me een halve dag per week. Voor dat tweede doe je het. Jij trekt de outbound groei in België. Je zoekt kantoren op, kwalificeert ze en legt contact via research, telefoon, mail, LinkedIn en events. Je voert discovery calls waarin de echte behoefte naar boven komt en geeft demo's die impact maken. Wat je gaat doen Jij bepaalt hoe we de Belgische markt aanpakken. Welke kantoren, langs welke weg, met welke opening. Je stuurt bij zodra je merkt wat aanslaat. Je bouwt en runt de volledige pipeline zelf: eerste contact, discovery, demo, bezwaren, onderhandeling. Je staat er niet alleen voor, het Saga team denkt mee. Je vertaalt wat je in de markt hoort naar een Belgisch playbook en deelt dat met sales, marketing en product. Wat jij hier leert, maakt ons overal beter. Je bouwt relaties die blijven duren, bij advocatenkantoren, juridische netwerken en lokale partners. Op events en workshops in heel het land ben jij het gezicht van Saga. Je houdt je pipeline realistisch en up-to-date in HubSpot, zodat jij en iedereen rond jou hetzelfde beeld van de markt hebben. Wat je aan kennis en ervaring meebrengt Je bent een commercieel professional die graag werkt in een omgeving met tempo. Je weet hoe je prospecteert, kwalificeert en deals vooruit helpt. Een nee blijft niet aan je plakken. En je kent dat moment waarop lauwe interesse omslaat in een concrete afspraak. Daar doe je het voor. Ervaring in B2B sales, account management of business development, in SaaS, technologie of professional services. Aantoonbare ervaring met het opzetten en uitvoeren van een go-to-market aanpak voor complexe SaaS-producten. Ervaring met pipelinebeheer in een CRM zoals HubSpot of Salesforce. Sterke communicatie. Je voert discovery calls, geeft demo's en pakt bezwaren aan zonder dat het vertrouwen eronder lijdt. Interesse in waar AI echt iets bijbrengt in juridisch werk, en genoeg voeling met hoe advocaten werken om snel hun vertrouwen te winnen. Je bent woonachtig in België en kunt commerciële gesprekken en onderhandelingen in het Nederlands, Frans en Engels voeren. Waarom kiezen voor Saga We zijn met juristen, engineers en bouwers, verspreid over meerdere landen en continenten. Klein genoeg dat je iedereen kent, groot genoeg dat er ervaring is met groeien over de grenzen heen. Werk je graag in een platte organisatie waar je zelf aan het stuur zit? Dan zit je hier goed. Wat we bieden: Een brutojaarloon van €55.000 tot €65.000, afhankelijk van ervaring, plus een bonusregeling. Betaalde verlofdagen, IT-materiaal en een vergoeding voor je verplaatsingen. Directe impact en verantwoordelijkheid vanaf dag 1. Ruimte om te experimenteren, en de steun om het te doen lukken. Remote set-up met hubs in Oslo en Amsterdam waar je altijd terechtkunt. Werk over de volledige breedte: van klantgesprekken tot meedenken met developers en juristen over het product. Een English-first werkomgeving met Noorse wortels en een groeiende Europese aanwezigheid. Wil jij België opbouwen voor Saga? Dan maken we graag kennis. Solliciteer via LinkedIn of neem contact op met Natalia Brodecka via natalia.brodecka@sagalegal.io.

review_candidates.title: PCBA Test Fixture Engineer
review_candidates.description: About The Business Tata Electronics Private Limited (TEPL) is a greenfield venture of the Tata Group with expertise in manufacturing precision components. Tata Electronics (a wholly owned subsidiary of Tata Sons Pvt. Ltd.) is building India’s first AI-enabled state-of-the-art Semiconductor Foundry. This facility will produce chips for applications such as power management IC, display drivers, microcontrollers (MCU) and high-performance computing logic, addressing the growing demand in markets such as automotive, computing and data storage, wireless communications and artificial intelligence. Tata Electronics is a subsidiary of the Tata group. The Tata Group operates in more than 100 countries across six continents, with the mission 'To improve the quality of life of the communities we serve globally, through long term stakeholder value creation based on leadership with Trust.’ Role Overview You will oversee end-to-end engineering of PCBA-based testing and automation systems — including ICT (In-Circuit Test), FVT (Functional Validation Test) fixtures, robotic integration, and automated equipment design — within high-volume manufacturing. Your expertise will span hardware design, automation systems, process engineering, and equipment deployment. Key Responsibilities Test Fixture & PCBA Design Design ICT/FVT test fixtures, including PCBA-based interface boards, load boards, and DUT connectors. Develop high-precision fixture layouts for electrical testing, pogo-pin sockets, and contact validation. Ensure SI/PI integrity for high-speed signals (e.g. digital I/O, RF, power rails), using controlled impedance designs and board stack-up practices. Support PCB schematic capture, layout review, and DFM/DFA compliance. Validation & Debug Drive hardware bring-up, fault diagnosis, and test debug during NPI/test-floor integration. Interface with failure analysis, yield engineering, and validation teams to optimize fixture performance and uptime. Handle process documentation, SOPs, validation metrics, and continuous improvement initiatives. Collaboration & Leadership Partner with cross-functional teams: process engineering, product/test engineering, SMT/assembly, and quality. Lead design reviews, project timelines, and handoffs for ICT/FVT and automation milestones. Mentor junior engineers, oversee vendor qualification for probe/fixture suppliers and robotic integrators. Required Qualifications Bachelor’s or Master’s in Electrical, Electronics, Mechatronics, Mechanical, or Industrial Engineering. 5–10+ years in PCBA test fixture design, automation tooling, robotic system deployment, or equipment engineering in electronics manufacturing. Proven experience with ICT, FVT, flying-probe, functional testers, or test handler systems. Strong background in PLC programming (Siemens, Allen‑Bradley, Omron), HMI design, and robot motion/control integration. Practical skills in SI/PI simulation and PCB layout tools (Cadence Allegro/SiWave, Mentor Xpedition, PADS). Solid understanding of DFM/DFA, SMT/ICT/FVT process environments, statistical process control, and quality systems (Lean, Six Sigma, FMEA). Hands-on debugging, validation, and automation deployment experience in manufacturing test floors. 6+ years of hands‑on experience with LabVIEW development and NI hardware platforms (e.g. cRIO, PXI, DAQms) Preferred & Soft Skills Expertise in designing fixtures and robotic test integrators for high-speed PCBA testing. Experience with IIoT data analytics, predictive maintenance, and digital twin simulation workflows. Effective communicator with strong documentation and cross-functional leadership. Ability to operate in fast-paced, high-volume manufacturing and automated test environments.
